title: Best 35 Pint Dehumidifier (2026): Mid-Size Picks Compared
h1: The Best 35-Pint Dehumidifiers for Large Rooms and Damp Spaces
dek: Bigger than a bedroom unit, lighter and quieter than a 50-pint basement box, a 35-pint dehumidifier is the sweet spot for living rooms, apartments and lightly damp basements.
description: The best 35 pint dehumidifiers for large rooms and light basements, from the Midea Cube 35 to Hisense and Keystone, plus 35 vs. 40-pint ratings explained.
intro: A **35 pint dehumidifier** is the middle size most people overlook. It has enough capacity for a living room, an open-plan apartment, a home gym or a basement that smells musty but doesn’t seep water, yet it’s smaller, lighter and usually quieter than the 50-pint units that dominate store shelves.

The catch is that “35 pints” doesn’t always mean the same thing. Since 2019, the Department of Energy rates dehumidifiers at 65°F instead of 80°F, so today’s 35-pint unit removes roughly what an older 50-pint did, while some listings still quote bigger numbers from hotter test conditions. Below are the 35-pint models worth buying, how to read the ratings, and how to decide between 35, 40 and 50 pints.
topPicksLead: For most large rooms and light basements, the **Midea Cube 35** is the best 35-pint dehumidifier: it’s honestly rated under the 2019 DOE test, holds an exact humidity target, and its oversized base tank needs emptying far less often.

For smaller rooms or wetter basements, compare the 20- and 50-pint Cubes in our [best Midea dehumidifier](/best/best-midea-dehumidifier/) guide.

blocks.text: We don’t lab-test. We compare DOE 2019 capacity ratings, ENERGY STAR listings, manufacturer coverage claims and manuals for humidistat range, drainage and defrost, and we check CPSC records for recalls. Owner reviews then tell us which units hold their humidity setting, which buckets leak, and which compressors fail after a season or two.
Because ratings in this class are so inconsistent, we gave extra weight to models with clearly stated DOE figures, and we flag in each review where a pint or coverage claim deserves caution.

sections.heading: What to look for in a 35 pint dehumidifier

items.label: A DOE 2019 rating
items.text: It’s the only figure you can compare across brands. Coverage claims of 2,000–3,000 sq ft are optimistic for this class.

items.label: A set-percentage humidistat
items.text: You want to dial in 45–50%, not just pick a fan speed. Our [humidistat settings guide](/guides/dehumidifier-humidistat-settings-guide/) has targets by room.

items.label: Drainage that fits the room
items.text: A gravity hose is standard in this class; built-in pumps are rare, so check where the nearest floor drain is.

items.label: ENERGY STAR certification
items.text: A mid-size unit often runs most of the summer, so efficiency adds up. See how much in our [electricity use guide](/guides/how-much-electricity-does-a-dehumidifier-use/).

items.label: Auto-defrost for basements
items.text: If the space sits in the 50s or low 60s, defrost keeps the coil from icing over.

blocks.text: You’ll still see 40-pint labels, mostly on older models or listings using pre-2019 test conditions. Under today’s test, those machines usually rate somewhere in the 20s, which makes them smaller than a modern 35-pint unit, not bigger. Compare DOE figures and you may find the 35 is the more capable machine.
When to skip 35 and go bigger

If water seeps through the walls or floor, or the space tops 1,500 square feet, a 35-pint unit will run nonstop and still fall behind. Our [best 50-pint dehumidifier](/best/best-50-pint-dehumidifier/) and [basement](/best/best-dehumidifier-for-basement/) guides cover that tier. For a single bedroom, a [30-pint](/best/best-30-pint-dehumidifier/) or 22-pint unit is quieter and cheaper.

The **Midea Cube 35** is the best 35 pint dehumidifier for most homes, thanks to an honest DOE rating, a precise humidistat and a tank that rarely needs emptying. The **Hisense 35-Pint** is the ENERGY STAR value pick, the **Perfect Aire** looks best in a living space, and the **Keystone** keeps things simple. Whatever you choose, compare DOE 2019 ratings rather than the number on the box.

faqs.q: What is the best 35 pint dehumidifier?
faqs.a: The Midea Cube 35, rated at 35 pints a day under the 2019 DOE test, with a humidistat that adjusts from 35% to 85% and a large base tank. The Hisense 35-Pint ENERGY STAR model is the value alternative.

faqs.q: How many square feet does a 35 pint dehumidifier cover?
faqs.a: Manufacturers often claim 2,000–3,000 square feet, but those figures are optimistic. Realistically, a 35-pint unit suits a large room or open area of 500–1,500 square feet, or a moderately damp basement of about 1,000 square feet.

faqs.q: Is a 40 pint dehumidifier bigger than a 35 pint?
faqs.a: Not necessarily. Most 40-pint labels come from the pre-2019 test, run at 80°F. Under today’s 65°F DOE test, those units usually rate in the 20s, so a modern 35-pint unit can remove more water.

faqs.q: Is a 35 pint dehumidifier enough for a basement?
faqs.a: For a basement that smells musty but stays dry, up to about 1,000 square feet, yes. If you see condensation on walls, seepage or standing water, choose a 50-pint unit or larger.

faqs.q: Are the Midea Cube 35 and Keystone 35-pint related?
faqs.a: Keystone dehumidifiers are built by Midea, but the Cube 35 is a different design, with a nested base tank, Wi-Fi control and a finer humidistat. The Keystone is the simpler, more conventional box.

faqs.q: What about GE, Insignia and Frigidaire 35-pint dehumidifiers?
faqs.a: All three sell 35-pint models, mostly through big-box stores, and Frigidaire offers Wi-Fi versions. Judge them by the same yardsticks as our picks: a DOE 2019 rating, a set-percentage humidistat, a gravity-hose outlet and ENERGY STAR certification.

faqs.q: Where can I find a 35 pint dehumidifier manual?
faqs.a: Check the model number on the label, usually on the back or inside the bucket cavity, and search the manufacturer’s support site. GE, Hisense, Frigidaire and Midea all post manuals for current models online.
